title: Aha E nyere Tupu A Mụọ
intro: Chee echiche banyere ebe nsọ dị jụụ jupụtara n'arịrịọ siri ike mgbe ọtụtụ afọ nke ichere gasịrị. Site n'ihe a na-adịghị ahụ anya, azịza na-abịa site na aha a na-enyebeghị mbụ, na-ekwe nkwa amamihe site na nwata na ndụ nke e ji nraranye, ọmịiko, na ịdị ọcha mara.
clues: Allah n'onwe ya kpọrọ m aha tupu a mụọ m, aha a na-enyebeghị onye ọ bụla tupu mụ.
Ndị nne na nna meworo agadi nyere m azịza nye arịrịọ siri ike, bụ́ ndị chere na ụmụ agaghị ekwe omume.
E nyere m amamihe, ikpe ziri ezi, na Akwụkwọ Nsọ mgbe m ka dị obere.
M na-ejere ndị mụrụ m ozi nke ọma, na-emekwa ndị ọzọ ebere, anaghịkwa m mpako ma ọ bụ na-enupụ isi.
Allah nyere iwu udo n'ahụ m n'ụbọchị a mụrụ m, n'ụbọchị m nwụrụ, na n'ụbọchị a ga-akpọlite ​​m n'ọnwụ.
Nna m Zakariyya natara ozi ọma gbasara m site n'aka ndị mmụọ ozi ka ọ na-eguzo n'ekpere n'ebe nsọ (mihrab).

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌۭ وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ وَٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرٌۭ ۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱللَّهُ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ
verse: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when I have reached old age and my wife is barren?" He [the angel] said, "Such is Allāh; He does what He wills." (3:40)
